baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مَسَّهُ / الشَّرُّ / جَزُوعًا links ingress, adverse content, and a resulting state.
baseline_models.mechanism: An adverse effect reaches the person at contact range and interrupts the capacity to continue composed; جَزُوعًا names the collapse of patience rather than mere dislike of pain.

activation_trace.role: The branch's effect reaching a person supplies the ingress point through which adversity becomes operative.
The branch's evil and badness supplies the adverse valence of what crosses that contact boundary.
The branch's collapse of patience supplies the terminal response and makes the contact an interruption of self-command.

changed_reading.before: Something bad happens and the person becomes alarmed.
changed_reading.after: Once adversity gains even contact-level access, it interrupts the person's continuing agency by collapsing patience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The punctual touch verb and the intensive state جَزُوعًا permit a threshold-and-break reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: Contact is the threshold event; the adverse encounter cuts crosswise through an ongoing course, shakes its parts loose, and leaves the person unable to carry the prior action through.

activation_trace.role: Literal tactile contact supplies a sharply bounded threshold rather than a prolonged condition.
The shredding and shaking-loose branch supplies the adverse encounter's disruptive material image.
Cutting or crossing across supplies the functional break in the person's prior course.

changed_reading.before: Panic is an inward feeling caused by misfortune.
changed_reading.after: Panic is a crosscutting failure of continuity: adverse contact makes the person abandon or break across what was underway.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: All three focus roots carry branches that can describe confusion becoming a whole-self reaction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adverse touch tangles perception, the person throws the whole self into the reaction, and patience collapses; the excess lies in totalizing a limited contact into an all-consuming state.

activation_trace.role: The branch's tangled confusion supplies the perceptual entanglement initiated at contact.
Throwing one's whole self into something supplies the reaction's disproportionate total commitment.
Collapse of patience converts perceptual entanglement into loss of behavioral continuity.

changed_reading.before: The person reacts strongly to a large evil.
changed_reading.after: The defect is amplification: a bounded adverse touch recruits the whole self into tangled panic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier patience command names the exact counter-operation to جَزُوعًا: holding the self so that adverse contact does not terminate composure.

activation_trace.role: Collapse of patience supplies the focus failure that the context can now oppose precisely.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the explicit counter-capacity whose failure defines the focus response.

structural_cues: 70:5 uses an imperative and cognate accusative before 70:20 presents the opposing response-state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier command to hold the self from panic and a focus adjective of patience-collapse; I infer a functional opposition, while the live alternative is that 70:5 addresses a different addressee without modeling the later human type.

changed_reading.before: جَزُوعًا is simply an intense emotion.
changed_reading.after: جَزُوعًا is failure of a named regulatory act: the self is not held through contact but lets the contact end its composure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A severe event is already descending and settling, but human assessment places it far away while the counter-assessment places it temporally near; مَسَّهُ is the abrupt conversion of mismeasured distance into contact.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching the person supplies the endpoint at which temporal expectation becomes felt contact.
Collapse of patience supplies the behavioral consequence of that compressed transition.
The severe descending event supplies an already advancing adverse process rather than an accidental nuisance.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the human estimate that postpones felt urgency.
Temporal nearness and an ending coming due supplies the counter-estimate that makes contact imminent.

structural_cues: 70:6-7 directly oppose two assessments of the same event's distance after 70:1 calls it واقع.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, opposed distance estimates, and later contact; I infer that miscalibrated imminence sharpens the panic spike, while a live alternative is that the distance contrast concerns only the final event and not ordinary adverse contacts in 70:20.

changed_reading.before: Adversity arrives suddenly and causes panic.
changed_reading.after: Panic is intensified by temporal miscalibration: what was treated as far is allowed no preparatory reality until its already-advancing effect touches the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Under overwhelming harm, panic becomes a social severing operation: bonds of companionship, clan, and shelter are converted into ransom so that the self might obtain rescue by separation.

activation_trace.role: Cutting or crossing through supplies the focus-anchored severing operation enacted upon social bonds.
Collapse of patience supplies the pressure under which the severing becomes thinkable.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the conversion of persons into substitutional payment.
Companionship and close adherence supplies a bond whose normal function is reversed by the ransom wish.
A man's near clan supplies the protective social unit placed inside the proposed exchange.
Joining a sheltering collective supplies the clan's protective function that panic attempts to liquidate.
Rescue by separation supplies the desired outcome and closes the severing mechanism.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 accumulates children, spouse, brother, sheltering clan, and everyone on earth under a single لو يفتدي wish.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ransom, intimate bonds, shelter, and rescue-by-separation; I infer that this sequence externalizes the cutting force latent in ج ز ع, while the live alternative is that it depicts a unique eschatological bargain rather than the ordinary mechanism of panic.

changed_reading.after: Panic can remain highly purposive but antisocial: it tries to preserve the self by cutting through and pricing the very bonds that normally shelter it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus response is the first conditional output of a created high-gain disposition: quick agitation converts adverse input into panic before deliberation can contain it.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching the person supplies the input channel for the disposition.
Collapse of patience supplies the adverse-output state produced by that channel.
Greedy panic and quick agitation supplies the encompassing disposition that generates the focus response.

structural_cues: 70:19 states the human disposition, and 70:20 follows immediately as an إذا-condition with an accusative response-state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a disposition clause followed by a conditional contact-response clause; I infer that 70:20 instantiates the disposition as a high-gain system, while the live alternative is that هَلُوعًا merely summarizes the two following adjectives without adding a causal model.

changed_reading.before: The person chooses panic after assessing an evil.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a low-latency disposition in which adverse input is amplified into patience-collapse before reflective assessment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated contact construction reveals one self-protective gate with valence-dependent outputs: adversity triggers disintegrative alarm, while beneficial gift triggers a hand closed against release.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching the person supplies the shared contact interface on the adverse side.
Evil and badness supplies the negative input whose threatened loss is borne by the self.
Collapse of patience supplies the negative-input output of the gate.
The same effect-reaching branch supplies an exact second pass through the contact interface.
Generosity and gift supplies the beneficial input that could move outward to others.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the positive-input output: benefit is retained rather than circulated.

structural_cues: 70:20-21 repeat وإذا/إذا مسه plus a valenced noun and intensive response adjective, changing only the input and output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact contact mirror, evil versus beneficial gift, and panic versus withheld giving; I infer one loss-averse gate that ejects distress and retains gain, while the live alternative is two adjacent but independent moral defects.

changed_reading.before: Panic is excessive sensitivity to pain alone.
changed_reading.after: Panic is one face of a broader loss-averse interface: the self cannot absorb adverse loss and cannot release beneficial gain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception sequence installs stabilizers before contact: binding practice, temporal continuity, fixed obligation, and vigilant adherence keep a momentary effect from monopolizing action.

activation_trace.role: Effect reaching the person supplies the perturbation that the stabilizing sequence must absorb.
Collapse of patience supplies the default discontinuity that precommitment counteracts.
Prayer as binding worship supplies a recurring commitment not chosen afresh under each pressure spike.
Stillness and continuity supplies the temporal persistence missing from the panic response.
A binding fixed obligation supplies an allocation rule that does not depend on the owner's momentary fear of loss.
Adherence and persistence supplies active maintenance of the stabilizing practice.

structural_cues: 70:22 opens an explicit exception, while 70:23 and 70:34 bracket the intervening obligations with repeated prayer clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exception, binding practice, continuity, fixed due, and maintenance; I infer a counter-architecture that regulates contact-reactivity, while the live alternative is that these clauses identify an exempt class without describing how exemption works.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an unalterable human essence.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes an unstructured default that can be displaced by durable practices and obligations established before adversity arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing scene gives panic a bodily trajectory: rapid movement is captured by a visible marker, then an overpowering covering ends in breakage under coercion. Reactive energy has inverted from recoil into compelled approach.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching the person supplies the focus transition from external pressure to embodied response.
Collapse of patience supplies the ungoverned reactive energy carried into the closing scene.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the bodily acceleration of the reaction.
An erected boundary marker supplies the fixed target that organizes otherwise uncontrolled speed.
Engulfing and overpowering supplies the pressure that overtakes the runners at the endpoint.
Breakage under coercion supplies the terminal condition of reactive self-command.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ف ض at 70:43 word 9 is used only structurally: its clause makes the rapid movement explicitly marker-directed.
70:43-44 moves from rapid emergence to directed motion and then to lowered sight and engulfing humiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speed, marker-directed syntax, engulfing pressure, and coercive breakage; I infer a terminal embodiment of the same ungoverned reactivity as جَزُوعًا, while the live alternative is an independent resurrection tableau with no psychological continuity to 70:20.

changed_reading.before: Panic means retreat from what harms.
changed_reading.after: Ungoverned reactivity can also be commandeered into rapid approach: the panicked body moves quickly yet no longer chooses its trajectory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the spark branch of ش ر ر rather than the ordinary evil branch; it remains anchored in the focus through the cited touch, spark, and patience-collapse chain, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for amplification rather than substitute 'spark' as the lexical translation of الشَّرُّ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places a contact verb immediately before a ش ر ر noun and a collapse-state, allowing a contact-to-propagation image.

activation_trace.role: Tactile contact supplies the small initiating point of the cascade.
Flying sparks supply an adverse effect that propagates beyond its tiny point of origin.
Collapse of patience supplies the large downstream state produced by the small initiating contact.

changed_reading.before: Response magnitude tracks the magnitude of the harm.
changed_reading.after: The reactive system behaves like spark propagation: a point contact can cascade into whole-state panic.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant ش ر ي mapping under the focus root and the small-portion branch of ج ز ع; it remains anchored by exact focus citations and gains contextual traction from withholding and fixed dues, but downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory transactional analogy, not as the lexical sense of الشَّرُّ or جَزُوعًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's split-mapped ش ر ر inventory and the portion branch of ج ز ع permit adversity to be modeled as an involuntary subtraction registered at contact.

activation_trace.role: An effect reaching the person supplies the moment at which the putative debit is registered.
Exchange through selling and buying supplies the non-dominant transactional frame for the adverse event.
A small cut-off portion supplies the perceived unit of subtraction to which the person overreacts.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the mirrored strategy for preventing any voluntary debit.
A binding fixed obligation supplies the contrasting allocation that remains due despite the owner's loss response.

changed_reading.before: The person fears evil and separately refuses generosity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the person treats every subtraction as an involuntary debit: panic contests imposed loss, and withholding blocks chosen loss until a fixed due overrides both.

strongest_changes: The explicit ص ب ر branch makes جَزُوعًا the collapse of a named counter-capacity, not merely intense fear.
The exact 70:20-21 contact mirror reveals panic and withholding as opposite outputs of one loss-averse gate.
The kin-ransom sequence externalizes panic as bond-severing, while the exception sequence supplies durable precommitments that can stabilize contact-reactivity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus combines an effect-contact root, a split-mapped adverse root, and a cutting/patience-collapse root; nearby context then provides an exact antonymic counter-capacity, a mirrored contact clause, and an exception framed by repeated practice.
remaining_uncertainties: The family-ransom sequence may depict a unique eschatological extremity rather than the ordinary social action of panic.
The exception list may identify an exempt class without proving that its practices causally regulate the focus disposition.
The spark, transactional, and compelled-rush readings remain branch-distant analogies and should not displace the dominant contact-and-patience-collapse model.
